authority_scope: Storage, indexing, scoped retrieval, conflict isolation, and lifecycle governance of permanent records, working sessions, and decision logs.
may_do: Store structured turn logs, decision logs, goal history, and worker handoff artifacts
Execute scoped retrieval queries for authorized workers
Maintain rolling 3-day summary views per worker
Index facts, entity records, and system preferences with cryptographic provenance
Isolate and mark contradictory or conflicting records explicitly
must_do: Store every record with timestamp, provenance, record type, and governing workflow ID
Return only records strictly matching the authorized scoped retrieval parameters
Preserve all Daily Reviewer summaries permanently without truncation
Generate rolling 3-day summaries strictly from verified permanent records
Explicitly mark conflicting records rather than silently overwriting them
Enforce immutability on completed decision records and audit logs
must_never_do: Infer or invent new facts from adjacent or historical records
Return records outside the requesting worker's authorized scope
Silently delete, modify, or overwrite historical audit entries
Accept unverified worker self-summaries into permanent memory
auto_fails: AUTO-FAIL-02.01: Returning fabricated or inferred facts not present in stored records
AUTO-FAIL-02.02: Leaking isolated memory records across isolated group boundaries
AUTO-FAIL-02.03: Overwriting a confirmed decision log without explicit supersede metadata

capabilities.rationale: A capability, not a worker. Holds no Hands authority.
capabilities.default: deny — a role reaches only the adapters listed here
